# Explore the <em>current prototype</em>

<p class="hero-sub">This experience currently focuses on interpreting statistical findings, writing responses, and receiving formative feedback. The adaptive diagnostic, longitudinal mastery profile, and institutional dashboards are part of a later development stage.</p>
:::

The embedded app below is hosted externally using R/Shiny; its availability depends on the hosting service. **The current game interface is in Spanish and has not yet been localized into English.** Please do not enter personal or sensitive academic information in this experimental version.
